variables.project_description: .NET 9 minimal API for managing tasks and owners with in-memory services, with xUnit unit and endpoint tests.
variables.architecture_notes: Program.cs is the composition root: it registers ITaskService/ITaskOwnerService implementations as singletons, then maps minimal HTTP endpoints directly to those services. Services maintain process-local lists and incrementing IDs; task creation validates an optional owner reference. Request records and storage models live under Models; owner endpoints map storage objects to TaskOwnerDto. Match the existing interface-backed service design, endpoint response conventions, nullable C# style, and tests around service behavior and HTTP responses. There is no database or persistence layer.
variables.test_conventions: Tests live in the nested DemoTaskApi.Tests project and use xUnit. Service tests instantiate service classes directly; endpoint tests use Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.Testing's WebApplicationFactory<Program> and HttpClient. Test classes/methods follow descriptive behavior-oriented names. Keep both unit-level service coverage and endpoint-level integration coverage.
variables.security_context_description: There is no authentication or persistent storage. The API accepts untrusted HTTP JSON input and route IDs; endpoint input validation, error handling and API data exposure are the principal relevant security concerns. This does not establish that repository or runtime secrets are absent.
variables.ticket_source_description: Jira, through the configured jira MCP server. Runtime namespace, tool availability and authentication remain unverified until actually checked.
variables.template_repo_location: ../test-copilot-marketplace (plugins/workshop-bootstrap/skills/bootstrap/assets/templates), relative to project_root. This local workshop source is a directory in the demo repository, not an installed plugin cache or a separate Git checkout. Retrospectives return proposals only.
